notes.title: Skulltide Update 2.0 !
notes.content: [p]Skulltide is joining the wizards at the [b]Wonders of Wizardry[/b] sale event this year with a brand new update, featuring a host of bugfixes and a [b]massive [/b]performance overhaul. Lessons from the third game in the Planar Danse, [i]The Fool's Apprentice[/i], have been brought back to [i]Skulltide[/i], and the game performs with overall 60% less GPU usage in all complex levels. [/p][p][/p][p]In my tests, the levels of Tel Sora and Zypressvald stressed streaming and rendering the most, and now frametimes have halved, doubling FPS in these levels! The game overall has a massive increase in performance on GPU and CPU, as tweaks to [url="https://emojipedia.org/skull"]💀[/url][b]enemy AI[/b][url="https://emojipedia.org/skull"]💀[/url] allowed for more intelligent use of resources. As such, the minimum specs for Skulltide have been slightly lowered :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you've been hesitant to delve into Skulltide, the game is now better than ever, and currently on discount through the event! Several rare but run-demolishing bugs have been quashed, and a little spot of necromancy might just be the spell you need this year for the Wonders of Wizardry! [url="https://emojipedia.org/mage"]🧙🧙🧙[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Click here to see the full roster of games included in the [b]Wonders of Wizardry[/b] event, hosted by the developer of Skulltide and the other games and novels in the universe. 106 games, including 60+ currently on discount![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/theplanardanse/sale/WondersofWizardry2025 " style="button"]Wonders of Wizardry 2025 Event[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, I hope you enjoy Skulltide :)[/p][p]K.S. Morii, TPD.[/p]

notes.title: Skulltide Full Release!
notes.content:
Skulltide comes now with its largest update, bringing it into a state of full release! This skeletal adventure game has been a blast to create, and thank you to all those who have followed along with it until now! A few more updates shall come to Skulltide, and to The Planar Danse overall--Read on for a big update to the next project!


[h2]New Ability Set[/h2]

Skulltide has received a big new update! Get the [b]Knights Adamant[/b] ability set, comprised of:
[list]
[*]Sanctify - adds a weapon buff for source/entropic damage that does pure damage to those whose soul is necromantically aligned. Dont hit your friends)
[*]Blade of the Diamond - A slower two-handed sword with wider swings and high damage.
[*]Riposte - Ever wanted to parry those pesty knights? Now you can!
[*]Battle Totem - Raise an explosive totem to provide buffs to nearby skeletons! It also explodes!
[*]Honorcall - A passive guard for you and all allies nearby, which can be toggled to provide massive Durability at the cost of speed.
[/list]



[h2]2 New Levels[/h2]

Also journey to two new levels, the Zypressvald, located in the Unsleeping Hollow of old Cospia, a cypress/pine wood caught in a heavy storm, with winding tree-paths; and Fel Scoria, the Magma Flats of Nocturne, a lava-ridden land of sinkholes and lava-boats.


Also check out the previous game in the Planar Danse for an occult narrative adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472060/Apollyon_River_of_Life/


[h2]Published Novel in The Planar Danse[/h2]

This is a story of fantasy/magical realism, a genre which takes the rules of the Planar Danse within their own logic and treats them as fact, exploring the reality of human experience around it. The theme is that of occultism and black magic in a land where such is not looked down upon, rather, interaction with the spiritual world is the norm. 

[b][i]Spirit's Almanac[/i], by K. S. Morii[/b]

In other lands the black magicks of occultism are hunted and burned at the stake; not so in Elysia. Here, spells are state mandates, spirits are firm allies, ghosts are kept instead of graves. None know this more than the agents of the Ministry, whose role is that of the use of and protection against the occult. One such name, Agent Yukiko, uses the hidden spirit world, the Twilight, to calm and catch rampant ghosts or devilish evils, alike. 

However, when the Twilight takes her in return, trapping her in wayward, timeless realms for 63 years, she returns with nary a connection to the Elysian Dynasty in the modern day. Her family passed, the world different, with war brewing and spirits inspired to violence. The Ministry, however, remains a steward of a precarious Dynasty under the rule of a drunkard Emperor given the title of Carnival Crown for his near-infinite debauchery and unending celebrations. It may not be the same Ministry she left behind in the world-before, but in order to keep the peace between the worlds of the physical and spiritual, she will need to navigate this black magic bureaucracy and play the part of witch and agent.
[i][/i]

International Stores: https://mybook.to/gybgH

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Multiplayer bugfixes
notes.content:

notes.title: Skulltide Releases this week! See what is in the game...
notes.content:
The [i][b]Skulltide[/b][/i] begins! As of today, necromantic shenanigans have come to Steam, and the Planar Danse returns for a second release. 

Skullltide launches today with its full upgrade and gameplay loop realized, feature complete in all its entropic glory. Get it today at a discount, and a greater discount if bundled with the previous game in the Planar Danse, Apollyon: River of Life!

---

There are three levels consisting of two more exploratory and the final gauntlet; in the final game the same structure will be echoed, having two more random/exploratory/resource-collecting levels before every "boss" level, whether or not that level has a "boss" or some other greater challenge. There are two ability sets of five abilities, and one additional hidden behind conversation, for a total of eleven abilities you can bind to your bones.

As updates come, minor and major, they will be placed upon the "beta" branch, which can be enabled in the Steam client Library, under game properties. They will remain here for 1+ day(s). For those of you reporting bugs through the Planar Danse discord channel, Steam community, or direct email (for those countries in which the former two locations are banned), please note if you are or are not on the beta branch. :)

---

More content will be coming to the game so long as the players & community continue to play, so spread the word to get more dark magic into your hands, and faster! The first update will bring the next enemy type to the toughest level, as well as the first of the third ability set.

Get it in the first week at a discount, and if you've been waiting to try this *and* the previous game from TPD, an additional 25% off can be found when bundled together, also on Steam! Just like Apollyon, more content will be coming to the game so long as the players & community continue to play, so spread the word to get more dark magic into your hands!

I'd like to thank those who stuck with me through the development of this game and the previous one from the Planar Danse. Skulltide will first and foremost always be for the players; the Planar Danse for the readers; and the world to be given & shared.

I wish each and every new skeleton a lengthy & entertaining unlife!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Weeklong Broadcast
notes.content:
Join us for Steam Next Fest and dive into the dark, atmospheric world of Skulltide. Unearth the secrets of necromancy, build your undead revolution, and carve your name into the annals of the damned. Will you conquer the underworld or succumb to its endless horrors? The journey begins now!


If you have a heart for the spooky and strange, or simply love roguelites with story and depth, Skulltide is right for you! Join a skeletal union and turn against the foolish necromancers who would raise you. The Skulltide begins!

------------------

Skulltide is an adventure, roguelite, necromantic RPG-lite, with co-op elements and a deep story. It has humorous elements in dark fantasy, with threads tying into an expansive universe continuing from the Planar Danse's previous release, Apollyon.

notes.content:
[list]
